decisions.governance_structure: Combined monthly programming under one shared charter, with an independent convener and facilitated joint sessions

commitments.detail: An independent convener will be appointed, no sole chairing by either existing co-chair, and facilitated joint sessions will be required for the combined meetings.
A written charter will be provided to members, and a formal review will be conducted after exactly 90 days.
Combined meetings will start at 2:00 p.m. with recordings and asynchronous access provided for all sessions.

A separate opt-in vote by each existing group must be conducted, with approval from at least two-thirds of voting members in each group, before the merged program can launch. Results must be documented before launch.
